root_cause.text: The `sve_set_common()` function in `arch/arm64/kernel/ptrace.c` incorrectly guards the setting of the `TIF_SVE` thread flag behind a `system_supports_sme()` check, which prevents the flag from being set during SVE register writes on systems that support SVE but do not support SME.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of the `if (system_supports_sme())` check surrounding the switch statement that sets `TIF_SVE` via `set_tsk_thread_flag(target, TIF_SVE)` when `type` is `ARM64_VEC_SVE`.
